name: Canadian English
notes: Canadian English. Rhotic; close to GA with: CANADIAN RAISING: /aɪ/ → [ʌɪ] before voiceless C (knife, ice); /aʊ/ → [ʌʊ] before voiceless C (out, about). CAUGHT-COT merger universal. Source: Wells (1982) vol. 3.

sources.author: Wells, J.C.
sources.title: Accents of English, Vol. 3: Beyond the British Isles

location.notes: Canada's representative point. A national variety: weak. [Wikidata Q16 P625]

allophone_rules.notes: Rhotic: /r/ is preserved in every position, so the RP coda-/r/ deletion this spec inherits does not apply (Wells 1982 vol.1 §3.2.2). Declared with no target phonemes, the id-keyed way a dialect states it lacks a parent's process.
